# Lazu

> Call Claude, GPT, Gemini and DeepSeek with one OpenAI-compatible API key. Pay as you go, no subscription. The stable lane runs on official APIs, every request is itemized, and Lazu never trains on your data.

## Key facts

- OpenAI-compatible at `https://api.lazu.ai/v1/*` — change `base_url` and reuse official SDKs
- Native provider endpoints also supported (Anthropic Messages and Gemini)
- No more signing up with every provider
- Give everyone a cap that actually stops
- One key per person, so a leak costs one key
- A bill you can read and hand to finance
- Automatic failover on upstream error

## Pages

- [Home](https://lazu.ai/): product overview · [中文](https://lazu.ai/zh/) · [繁體](https://lazu.ai/zh-TW/) · [日本語](https://lazu.ai/ja/)
- [FAQ](https://lazu.ai/faq): common questions about migration, payment, models
- [About](https://lazu.ai/about): who operates Lazu (DUBRIO LLC, Delaware) and how to reach us
- [Privacy Policy](https://lazu.ai/privacy): how Lazu handles account, API usage, OAuth, and payment information
- [Terms of Service](https://lazu.ai/terms): terms for accounts, gateway usage, and billing

## Models

- [Model catalog](https://lazu.ai/models): every model with live prices on both lanes, context length and capabilities ([Markdown](https://lazu.ai/models.md))
- Each model has its own page, e.g. `https://lazu.ai/models/anthropic/<model>`, with a `.md` and a `.json` sibling
- Machine-readable models and prices: [https://lazu.ai/models.json](https://lazu.ai/models.json)
